# ReportPortal

> Open-source TestOps platform for centralized test reporting, AI-powered failure analysis, and real-time quality analytics.

## Main Pages

- [ReportPortal test automation analytics platform and real-time reporting, powered by Machine Learning](https://reportportal.io/): Centralized test automation dashboard. Provides AI-based defects triage and real time test report dashboard.
- [Community](https://reportportal.io/community/): Connect, learn, and collaborate with testing enthusiasts. Join the ReportPortal community.
- [Features](https://reportportal.io/features/): Explore features for seamless test automation. Rethink end-to-end testing with automated defect triaging and a dynamic QA metrics dashboard.
- [Installation guide](https://reportportal.io/installation/): Three steps to get started with our test automation dashboard.
- [Quality Engineering Consulting](https://reportportal.io/qe-consulting/): Achieve a product-quality transformation with our outstanding Quality Engineering Consulting.
- [Test Automation as a Service](https://reportportal.io/test-automation-as-a-service/): Enhance your testing process by utilizing our on-demand automation tools, infrastructure, hardware, and expert resources.
- [Testing as a Service](https://reportportal.io/testing-as-a-service/): Optimize your testing costs with our on-demand software, hardware, and expert resources.
